svg.text: Inside one decoder layer: ten stops, with shapes
DeepseekDecoderLayer.forward in a decode step · mHC on · example sizes, not from the repo
T = 192 tokens · H = 4096 · m = hc_mult = 4 · k = top-k experts · trunk R = [T, m, H]
Into the layer, and through attention
The post mix of the previous MoE runs at the start of this layer, in the same call as the attention pre mix.
hidden x [192, 4096] bf16 (MoE out of layer i-1, not yet in the trunk)
Hooks and the YOCO boundary (some layers only)
Engram layers: make a hook that changes the trunk after the post mix
first YOCO consumer, compact prefill only: make compact copies of the rows
mHC post of the previous MoE
R = mhc_post(x, R_old, post, comb): comb @ R_old + post * x
mHC pre and the attention norm
new lazy: R, post [1, 192, 4, 1], comb [1, 192, 4, 4], pre or None
DFlash hook and YOCO shared hidden
target layers: mean of the 4 streams of R -> dflash_input[:, j*4096:(j+1)*4096]
first YOCO consumer: keep a clone of the bf16 norm output as shared hidden
Attention: MLA, SWA and compressed keys, indexer
(fp8, scales) + bf16 [192, 4096], kv_cache of layer i, cross-layer runtime
The MoE half, and the way out
The MoE output leaves the layer as a single stream. The trunk gets it only in the next layer.
mHC post of attention, and pre for the MoE
ffn_norm_forward: same code as stop 3 + 4, with the MoE's cast arguments
fp8 input (mega MoE: written into its buffer) + bf16 [192, 4096], new lazy
The gate picks k experts per token
topk_idx, topk_weights [192, k]: physical expert slots and weights
mega MoE: one DeepGEMM call · else DeepEP dispatch, 2 grouped GEMMs,
shared expert, combine (shared output added as bias) -> bf16 [192, 4096]
Out: the layer returns, the MoE post waits
(MoE out [192, 4096], lazy residual): post runs in layer i+1, stop 3
after the last layer: post + fold (deepseek.py:225-239) -> [192, 4096]
Not shown: timers (decoder_layer.py:120-133, 164-168), CUDA graph capture, context parallelism.
Simplified: 'comb @ R_old + post * x' is a model of the post kernel (not in the repo); it fits flops_estimator.hpp:107-111.
On GPU with m = 4 and H a multiple of 1024, stops 3 and 4 (and 7) are one deep_gemm.mega_mhc call (hc.py:97-101, 195-202).
